name: Sunken Valor
look: an Azelf whose blue head is a long hood curling over to one side, with a red brow gem, yellow eyes, teal spotted shoulder fins and two very long trailing tails ending in red-gemmed lobes
entry: A Pokémon resembling Azelf, described in a fisher's tale of a drowned spirit that rose from a still swamp. It is said to lend its courage to the lost, and to drag the cowardly down.
how: Wild: very rare at night in swamps.
